text:
Find an orthogonal diagonalization, if one exists, for the following matrices.

$ \begin{bmatrix} 11 \amp 4 \amp 12 \\ 4 \amp -3 \amp -16 \\ 12 \amp -16 \amp 1 \end{bmatrix} $.

$ \begin{bmatrix} 1 \amp 0 \amp 2 \\ 0 \amp 1 \amp 2 \\ -2 \amp -2 \amp 1 \\ \end{bmatrix} $.

$ \begin{bmatrix} 9 \amp 3 \amp 3 \amp 3\\ 3 \amp 9 \amp 3 \amp 3\\ 3 \amp 3 \amp 9 \amp 3\\ 3 \amp 3 \amp 3 \amp 9\\ \end{bmatrix} $.
